markingAuditRisks: Physics examiner guidance: an incorrect statement may negate a correct statement; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
Calculations generally permit a correct answer without working unless the source demands method evidence or a correct result can arise from wrong physics.
Carry-forward marks only where official mark scheme permits; never mix incompatible alternative calculation routes.
01.1 graph-area method, 01.3 slope choice and 01.5 graphical multiple-choice need visual source context.
02.3 is a six-mark level-of-response question requiring holistic quality and coverage of flywheel shape, materials and high-speed operation.
03.4 and 03.5 require drawn/annotated indicator diagrams, so plain text-only auto-marking cannot fully verify them.
04.1 demands temperature conversion to Kelvin for theoretical coefficient of performance and valid final comparison.
verification: Verified against official 20-page June 2022 AQA question paper, 15-page final v1.0 mark scheme and current AQA specification. This audit contains editorial skill summaries and source references, NOT copyrighted question stems, diagrams, model answers or playable practice.
